verdict.rationale: Docs show all three provisioning surfaces — the SDK/API for creating assistants (vapi-docs-1), the CLI for managing 'assistants, phone numbers, and calls' entirely from the terminal (vapi-docs-2, vapi-docs-31), and the MCP server exposing the same assistant/number/call management to any MCP-compatible agent (vapi-docs-5, vapi-docs-33, vapi-docs-37) — covering the full create-agent/attach-number/place-call flow without the dashboard. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end example (single walkthrough) chaining create→attach→call purely via CLI or MCP rather than separate feature mentions, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
